What the widget displays

The widget shows the latest scheduled GoldAlert daily close, the daily percentage change and the existing HOLD, 50% BUY / WATCH or 100% BUY / STRONG pullback stage. Currency conversions are indicative reference rates and are not dealer quotes.

Keep the GoldAlert attribution and methodology link intact. Data may be delayed or revised and is provided for educational use only.
